notes:
Lead source: inbound (blog post + free credits). Small ecommerce app (Shop-embedded bot) — primary need is customer support chat + lightweight product recommendations. Wants <1s median reply for chat; throughput low (50–200 msgs/day). Very cost sensitive — wants to keep hosted API until traction then consider Dedicated. Main discussion points:
- Data retention: 'How long do you keep request/response logs? Can we opt-out of storage for sensitive prompts?'
- Prompt storage: they asked whether prompts are stored in raw form, and whether Redwood can redact PII automatically or if that must happen client-side.
- Opt-out / opt-in: wants a way for end-users to opt-out of analytics and model logging (marketing/legal ask).
- Logs & telemetry: would like ability to get aggregated usage only (no raw prompts) and an option to turn off transcript retention beyond 30 days.
- Legal: startup lawyer asked for a short SLA line about retention + right-to-delete; will need example clause for procurement.
- Trust signals requested: SOC2 cert copy, export controls, data residency statement (they host in us-east).
- Quote from call: 'We can't keep raw customer messages longer than a month — that's a hard line for our merchant agreements.'
- Technical ask: example API header or param to mark request as 'no-store' or 'no-log' and whether that is honored in hosted tier.
- POC plan: test in prod with sampling + redact pipeline; will evaluate whether standard hosted API meets needs or if we need Dedicated with VPC later.
Notes: AE left recap in thread, SE to propose 'no-store' pattern and retention SLA. Legal is the gating item. Budget decision targeted next month.
